hints.title: Geographical Continent Pivot Table
hints.text: Pivot alphabetical student names from rows into three columns (America, Asia, Europe) aligned by index rank.

hints.title: Row Number Partitioning and Conditional Aggregation
hints.text: Assign row_number ordered by student name within each continent. Then group by row number and use conditional max statements.

hints.title: Pivot Blueprint
hints.text: With Ranked as (select name, continent, row_number() over(partition by continent order by name) as rn from Student) select max(case when continent = "America" then name end) as America, max(case when continent = "Asia" then name end) as Asia, max(case when continent = "Europe" then name end) as Europe from Ranked group by rn.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH Ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        continent,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY continent ORDER BY name) AS rn
    FROM Student
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN continent = 'America' THEN name END) AS America,
    MAX(CASE WHEN continent = 'Asia' THEN name END) AS Asia,
    MAX(CASE WHEN continent = 'Europe' THEN name END) AS Europe
FROM Ranked
GROUP BY rn;
```

complexity.notes: Window ranking and conditional grouping pivot names in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full outer joining separate continent subqueries creates verbose and fragile join chains.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Partitioned row ranking groups disparate categories in a single pivot pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY continent) and MAX(CASE WHEN) pivot pattern.
